name: a leg for a pin outside pin_order is written, and the sheet never reads it
find: bad = [key for key, text in legs.items() if key not in pins or not _words(text)] if isinstance(legs, dict) else ["the value"]
replace: bad = [key for key, text in legs.items() if not _words(text)] if isinstance(legs, dict) else ["the value"]

name: an empty leg text is written
find: bad = [key for key, text in legs.items() if key not in pins or not _words(text)] if isinstance(legs, dict) else ["the value"]
replace: bad = [key for key, text in legs.items() if key not in pins] if isinstance(legs, dict) else ["the value"]

name: an empty host requirement line is written
find: bad = [index for index, line in enumerate(lines) if not _words(line)] if isinstance(lines, list) else ["the value"]
replace: bad = [] if isinstance(lines, list) else ["the value"]

name: a sheet key's text is cut at the label cap, not the provenance cap
find: return _scrubbed(value, PROVENANCE_MAX) if key in PROVENANCE_KEYS + SHEET_KEYS else _scrubbed(value)
replace: return _scrubbed(value, PROVENANCE_MAX) if key in PROVENANCE_KEYS else _scrubbed(value)
